specific-carbohydrate-polymer-structure.reason: The molecular structure of specific carbohydrate polymers is outside current exam scope.

specific-lipid-molecular-structure.reason: The molecular structure of specific lipids is outside current exam scope.

specific-nucleotide-molecular-structure.reason: The molecular structure of specific nucleotides is outside current exam scope.

amino-acid-molecular-structure.reason: The molecular structure of amino acids is outside current exam scope.

smooth-er-specialized-function-detail.reason: Specific functions of smooth ER in specialized cells are outside current exam scope.

golgi-specialized-synthesis-packaging-de.reason: Golgi synthesis of specific phospholipids and packaging of specific enzymes for lysosomes, peroxisomes, and secretory vesicles are outside current exam scope.

gibbs-free-energy-equation.reason: The Gibbs free-energy equation is outside current exam scope, although the concept of energy is in scope.

calvin-cycle-memorization.reason: Memorizing Calvin-cycle steps, molecular structures, and enzyme names other than ATP synthase is outside current exam scope.

electron-carrier-full-names.reason: Full names of specific electron carriers in electron transport chains are outside current exam scope.

energy-pathway-step-enzyme-intermediate-.reason: Specific pathway steps, enzyme names, and intermediates beyond the named exceptions are outside current course and exam scope.

glycolysis-krebs-memorization.reason: Memorizing glycolysis and Krebs-cycle steps, molecular structures, and enzyme names is outside current course and exam scope.

specific-cyclin-cdk-growth-factor.reason: Specific cyclin-CdK pairs and growth factors are outside current exam scope.

sexual-reproduction-cycle-detail.reason: Details of sexual reproduction cycles in particular plants and animals are outside current exam scope.

unlisted-dna-replication-enzyme-detail.reason: Names of replication steps and enzymes other than DNA polymerase, ligase, RNA polymerase, helicase, and topoisomerase are outside current exam scope.

translation-enzyme-factor-detail.reason: Details and names of enzymes and factors involved in translation steps are outside current exam scope.

genetic-code-memorization.reason: Memorizing the genetic code other than the start codon AUG is outside current exam scope.

specific-mutation-effect-detail.reason: Knowledge of specific mutations and their effects is outside current exam scope.

chromosome-number-disorder-detail.reason: Knowledge of specific disorders related to changes in chromosome number is outside current exam scope.

genetic-engineering-technique-detail.reason: Procedural details of the listed genetic-engineering techniques are outside current exam scope.

behavioral-physiological-mechanism-detai.reason: Specific behavioral or physiological response mechanisms are outside current exam scope.

communication-mechanism-detail.reason: Specific mechanisms of organismal communication are outside current exam scope.

communication-behavior-system-detail.reason: Details of communication and community behavioral systems are outside current exam scope.
